gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically or cytologically confirmed glioblastoma(WHO 2021).

candidate_evidence.quote: NRG-103 is an oncolytic virus, which can kill GBM cells via three manners.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients have experienced recurrence (RANO 2.0) after previous anti-tumor treatments

role_evidence.quote: NRG-103 is an oncolytic virus, which can kill GBM cells via three manners.

agents.drug_class_hint: genetically modified oncolytic adenovirus (gene therapy) expressing transdifferentiation transcription factors
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: it can enhance the specific recognition and killing effect of oncolytic virus on GBM tumor cells without being limited by tumor gene phenotype, and regulate the immune microenvironment

coder_notes: Single-arm oncolytic adenovirus gene therapy; excluded intervention type. Registered phase EARLY_PHASE1.
